claims.statement: Muay Thai originated in Thailand and is known as the art of eight limbs (fists, elbows, knees, shins).
Modern kickboxing developed from multiple lineages including Japanese kickboxing (1950s-60s), American kickboxing, and Dutch kickboxing.
Standard kickboxing rulesets (e.g. WAKO, K-1) do not permit elbow strikes or prolonged clinch, unlike Muay Thai under IFMA rules.
Any specific calorie-burn comparison between Muay Thai and kickboxing.
